how: Calls recruit participants for building, expanding, reinforcing and finishing particular marks
Proposing an additional neighbouring flag instantiates starting without requiring evidence that others joined
Members judge hands and space inadequate for additional commitments
A title asks whether an apparent image represents a hostile takeover without establishing the image's contents
Considering giving up and warning about escalation do not establish actual withdrawal or repair of a personal quarrel
Members propose repositioning the stripe and lettering, changing the name and refining a friendship heart
Timed pixel instructions make a common flag shift executable
A later report announces a formed flag beside existing neighbouring logos without establishing an attack
Invitations route alliance discussion and future problems through shared chats while internal decisions remain unseen
Circulating a planning sheet and relaying a proposal to another subreddit require recognition beyond chat routing or demonstrated coalition membership
A choice between giving up and botting establishes automation deliberation while deployment and effectiveness remain unresolved
Local participants sleeping creates an explicit need for defence from another time zone
Pixel instructions and a bot proposal do not establish site malfunctions or technical fixes
Timed coordination and unseen chat decisions do not decide whether canvas leadership or decision rules were established
A bare assent accepts a diplomatic proposal without requesting anything back
Messaging participants in a shared construction episode does not establish hiding plans from rivals or infiltrating rival venues
Members repair lettering and cover defence shifts while intended changes can also be undone as apparent damage
A builder attributes repeated reversals to others mistaking construction for damage
A neighbour's request receives a flag-shifting counterproposal and a separate peace proposal receives explicit assent
A request to spare neighbouring art directly elicits a request for help moving the flag
Negotiating room for neighbouring art leads to a shifting counterproposal followed by timed instructions for redesign
A stop request and a member's report of restoring a neighbour's name establish restraint rather than another attack
Participants offer reciprocal protection, report upkeep, thank collaborators and decline extra help when hands are scarce
A completed joint heart demonstrates cooperation independently of coalition invitations whose uptake remains unobserved
A standing flag's stripe is shifted to accommodate neighbouring art without an evidenced preceding loss
Spatial adjustment of a standing design does not establish relocation after erasure or being overrun
Relaying the label-change proposal to another subreddit fits minimal envoy activity without establishing formal appointment or authority
A diplomacy invitation and a later neighbouring flag do not establish host rules governing guest work
Disappointment about covering receives a participant's explanation of redirected raiding, without establishing a shared general ethic
Assent to peace and individual restoration do not explicitly state who can commit all placers
Treaty acceptance and later differing conduct do not show an explicit post-agreement dispute over who may commit the room
Helping neighbours and calling them brothers do not establish dual membership or divided allegiance
National pride and Viking history enter participants' accounts of the canvas work and its neighbours
Viking history names a target within the contest talk without establishing that a prior quarrel caused target selection
A historical raiding reference does not establish a specific quarrel carried from before the canvas
Historical raiding banter makes jokes out of the work and its neighbours without establishing a durable new running gag
Sharing a chat link does not establish founding a new canvas community or gathering its followers into a new room
Recounting repair of the national name does not establish a debate over offensive words or hate symbols
Explicit April Fools references frame local jokes while isolated titles remain contextually ambiguous
A moderator concentrates canvas discussion in a megathread and announces deletion of individual threads
Moderating canvas posts does not establish turning against the room's pixel mark because of the post flood
Participants celebrate completion, thank collaborators and reflect on having held ground together
Members announce the end and retrospectively recount repeated repair of the national name
Dissatisfaction with one surviving pixel does not establish contesting a shared post-event copy or historical account
Closing congratulations and reflection do not establish successor canvases or durable organisational commitments
Visitors thanking collaborators do not establish recruitment into the room's ordinary activity through the canvas mark
Credits exchanged with canvas collaborators do not show addressing creators, press or other audiences outside the canvas
Calls propose raiding or converting flags without proving that each suggested attack occurred
A complaint receives historical raid banter and a participant's explanation of abandoning one target for another
A call and a separately reported flag do not establish that recruited participants built the same work
The additional flag proposal and a later synchronisation instruction leave the intervening recruitment mechanism unestablished
An extra-flag report and repair accounts do not establish building preceding upkeep for the same mark
Maintenance and a later name agreement coexist while the directly evidenced neighbour exchange concerns spatial adjustment during construction
Personal restoration and treaty assent do not establish that the agreement caused that individual's repair
Repeated repair and the later botting option do not by themselves establish an implemented transition to machine upkeep
A built-flag report and separate completion thanks do not establish the reporting-to-celebration mechanism for the same work
Celebration and retrospective recording coexist without establishing that celebration caused a separate preservation effort
The closing retrospective leaves the proposed transition from records to enduring continuation untested
Refusing an additional help request does not test a mechanism about moving after being unable to hold one's own spot
Timed instructions demonstrate a design plan without establishing that posting a template settled prior design disagreement
The coded bare assent answers a diplomatic proposal rather than a mobilisation call
Anticipated insufficient upkeep motivates seeking outside support while the coded appeal does not establish that the requested help arrived
Recruitment and attack calls coexist without showing that the same recruited participants were redirected against a rival
Standalone restraint and later personal restoration do not directly answer the coded Britain or Norway attack calls
Separate invasion and peace proposals do not establish that a particular attack call elicited the proposed agreement
Attack proposals and later taunts do not establish the specific causal mechanism between attack and contest talk
Seeking defensive support establishes motivation but not demonstrated coalition membership and subsequent mutual defence
The coded recruitment call and moderation instruction do not independently establish that mobilisation caused the post flood
